legitimate_corrected_input_strategy.advisory_result: Reasonable equivalent verification design, conditional on transparent main-owned scope, offline integrity checks and actual final factual review. This is not permission to execute an API call or a guarantee of a pass.
legitimate_corrected_input_strategy.why_distinct: The new purpose is correcting a documented lossy test-input transformation, not resetting or silently retrying an exhausted case with unchanged inputs. The prior semantic run stays a completed response with a unit-error factual failure.
preserve: Every previously chosen operational fact, all retained incidents and command history, source identities, differing timestamps, current-run history limits and recovery-count semantics
Full original captures and their hashes, prior prompts/model responses, exhausted policies and shared cumulative accounting
The fact that the new MCP capture was harness-selected and zero-inference, while earlier model-selected operations were separate evidence
The historical-record interpretation scope, maintainer prerequisites, physical simulation and absence of operations in the explanation turn
legitimate_corrected_input_strategy.restore: Treat each selected measurement as an inseparable value/unit/observed_at/received_at/source/quality object from the original capture. Preserve the target's canonical unit association using the actual contract; do not manually invent or convert units. If a source unit is unavailable, report it as unknown.
legitimate_corrected_input_strategy.out_of_band_provenance: Long forensic JSON pointers and repeated file hashes can move to a separately hashed source-to-packet manifest. The model-facing packet still needs meaningful source labels, capture/observation times and the relations among records. Removing repeated forensic syntax is acceptable; removing operational facts or qualifiers to fit is not.
legitimate_corrected_input_strategy.do_not_supply: No corrected answer, synthetic assistant/tool history, rewritten prior transcript, fabricated current reading or hidden factual substitution.
offline_preconditions: An automated map compares every original selected value with its new packet location, with no silent deletion or alteration
All five selected measurement objects carry their exact source units/timestamps/provenance/quality; a missing-unit packet fails before any live request
Earlier acknowledged command, unresolved incident, all three zone statuses/reasons and recovery/history scope remain present
Each source hash and transformed-packet hash is recorded; the main records the transformation and corrected-input purpose before execution
An unchanged conservative reservation estimator and zero-call preflight fit the complete planned request under both a newly fixed test limit and the current shared remainder
legitimate_corrected_input_strategy.live_execution_boundary: Only main may decide whether to perform a single explicitly bounded corrected-input regression. This advisory approves no call. Do not reset previous caps, shared counters or reservations, lower the estimator, raise shared limits, or loop on stochastic variants. If preflight cannot fit within the remaining fixed batch, leave the gate open.

Any quoted measurement uses the supplied value and unit correctly; the captured airflow is 200 m³/h and the source target is in the same canonical flow unit
Prior action/ACK, unresolved status and qualifying post-ACK recovery samples remain distinct
